title: yadgar/config
description: THIS CHART READS A HELM VALUE FOR EXACTLY THE KNOBS chart/consequential.yaml DECLARES, AND THAT LIST IS EMPTY. Every knob lives in chart/config/<service>.yaml or chart/config/shared.yaml and chart/templates/configmap.yaml copies those documents verbatim with .Files.Get, so today a key set here, in an adopter's values file, or with --set is read by nothing. This schema closes that hole: it refuses the value rather than ignoring it. Helm enforces it in both helm lint and helm template, which is the `helm lint and render` pre-commit hook and therefore `ci / passed`.
$comment: WHY A REFUSAL RATHER THAN A DEFAULT-SHAPED ALLOWANCE. A value this chart cannot read is the silent no-op ADR-0569 exists to delete, one layer out: an operator sets pollSeconds and nothing anywhere says the number was dropped. An empty `properties` with `additionalProperties: false` is the whole of the rule, and the message names the offending key, which is enough to find the line. THE INTERFACE AND THIS SCHEMA OPEN TOGETHER, KNOB BY KNOB. chart/consequential.yaml names the knobs that carry no default under ADR-0705 rule 2, this file gives each of them a type and bounds, and scripts/one_source_per_knob.py refuses the two disagreeing in either direction — so neither can open a hole the other does not know about. `additionalProperties: false` STAYS, at every level: it is what keeps a key with no reader a refusal rather than a rubber stamp, and that behaviour survives the interface rather than being traded for it. REQUIRED-NESS IS NOT EXPRESSED HERE. chart/templates/configmap.yaml calls Helm's `required` instead, because ADR-0705 asks for a refusal naming the knob AND the file, while helm's own schema error says `archive is required` on helm 3 and `missing property 'archive'` on helm 4, names no file, and is not this repository's wording to own. See the README's Blast radius section for which knobs carry a default and which would not; all four carry one today, which is why `properties` is empty.
